title: Contractor SAIC likely involved in psionic research

tellings.quote:
into, you know, the specific contractor

plain: SAIC, a large US government contractor, was likely involved in psychotronic or psionic research, meaning research into the supposed powers of the mind. Michels says this himself in a 2025 episode with a guest known as UAPGerb, and names no source for it beyond his own reading of the contractor's role.
